entities.summary: Andrea Magi is a former amateur boxer from Italy. He is best known for winning the bronze medal at the 1987 European Championships in Turin, Italy in the Men's Light Heavyweight division. He represented his native country at the 1988 Summer Olympics in Seoul, South Korea. Andrea Magi was a athletes & competitors from Pesaro (b. 1966-07-14, Pesaro).
